source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Go With Chicken, University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service, Eau Claire County

ingredients.name: whole chicken, raw, cut into pieces, skin removed

steps.instruction: Place 4 sliced potatoes, 6 sliced carrots and 1 quartered onion in a roasting pan.
Put the pieces of 1 whole chicken on top of the vegetables.
Mix 1/2 cup of water, 1 teaspoon of thyme and 1/4 teaspoon of ground black pepper.
Pour the water mixture over the chicken and vegetables.
Bake for 1 hour, until browned and tender.
steps.spoken: Bake for 1 hour or more, until the chicken and vegetables are browned and tender.

steps.instruction: Spoon the juices over the chicken once or twice while it bakes.
